notes.subject: סָר סָבְאָם
notes.rationale: 'their drink is sour/turned aside' vs 'when their carouse is over' (JPS/BSB) — סור read literally or temporally

notes.subject: אהבו הבו קלון מגניה
notes.rationale: 'her shields loved give-shame': read as 'her protectors love shame — Bring!' (KJV/Geneva) or 'her lovers loved shame' — clause division disputed

notes.subject: mekim pasin nogut
notes.rationale: זנה is adultery/unfaithfulness, used of covenant betrayal — Tok Pisin idiom carries the wrongdoing sense

notes.subject: הזנה הזנו / אהבו הבו
notes.rationale: repeated near-identical verb pairs create a staggering-drunk rhythm, flattened in Tok Pisin

translation: Dring bilong ol i antap long senis; ol i mekim pasin nogut, ol i mekim inap long winim; ol bikman bilong en i laikim sem tru: 'Givim moa!'
